title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-18
lineage: SBD > MR > Reel > DAT > CDR > EAC > SHN > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Mixed audience‑board recording but the show shines with a monster Other One, stellar St Stephen > Not Fade Away, and high‑energy Me & My Uncle.
ai_review.review: The performance is highly praised – highlights include an epic The Other One, a ripping St. Stephen > Not Fade Away sequence, great Me & My Uncle, Operator and a soaring Cryptical Envelopment into Brokedown Palace. Recording quality is uneven: the first set suffers from crummy audience tape, while the second half switches to a clean soundboard source that sounds almost perfect.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the musical performance very highly (4‑5 stars) and cite several standout jams, while recording quality is mixed but improves dramatically in the second half, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First set recorded from the audience – muffled and noisy; second half captured from the soundboard with crisp clarity and excellent balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early audience tape captures raw crowd energy but sounds thin; once the board kicks in the set flows powerfully with tight jams and high‑energy transitions, especially in the second half.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for letting loose on The Other One and delivering an exhilarating St. Stephen solo with perfect tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as loud and clear even through the audience recording; bass work described as tight and prominent.
